verdict.rationale: Metronome's data-export docs refer to 'sandbox and production data' as separate datasets, which implies a first-party sandbox environment distinct from production. It is only a passing mention inside a data-export guide. Nothing documents how to provision or use the sandbox for testing, or how isolation is enforced. missing for 10: dedicated sandbox environment documentation, sandbox-specific API keys/endpoints, explicit isolation guarantees from production data, guidance for agent/automated testing workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Metronome can send your sandbox and production data directly to your data warehouse
